main.description: Resume a resident organism agent from its latest LangGraph checkpoint after pod restart / migration / dissolution recovery. Loads the most recent vertex_organism_checkpoint row by (did, thread_id), reconstructs the LangGraph state, and re-arms the resident tick loop. Idempotent: calling on an already-running organism is a no-op (returns currentCheckpointId).

threadId.description: LangGraph thread ID. Default = 'main' (one thread per organism).

checkpointId.description: Specific checkpoint to resume from. Default = latest by saved_at_ms.

force.description: Force resume even if runtime status is 'alive' (used for migration).

langgraphNode.description: Node where the checkpoint was taken; resume continues from here
